lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters located posterior to the gill slits, displaying a semi-stochastic arrangement with higher spatial density in the anterior-most region of the flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible intersecting with the primary spot rows, most notably in the region immediately behind the gill slits, forming a subtle grid-like structure of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A sharp horizontal feature is present along the upper third of the visible flank, displaying a high-contrast vertical gradient with a luminant upper margin and a shadowed ventral margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large, pale, circular or U-shaped anomaly is visible on the central lateral flank, indicated by a grey directional arrow; the feature represents a clear disruption of the standard epidermal pigmentation and spot pattern.
other_distinctive_markers: A zone of elevated spot density characterized by significantly smaller, more tightly packed high-luminance points is localized dorsoposterior to the gill slits.
